records.source: ops_read_neighbour_discount ({discount}) does not act under {method}; reads are not discounted
records.translation: ops_read_neighbour_discount ({discount}) hefur ekki áhrif undir {method}; vægi aflestra er ekki lækkað

records.source: Under ops_prefix_quality_method 'recipe_simple', ignore a minority barcode that has the most reads in a touching cell when ops_read_neighbour_discount is below 1. Tied top barcodes remain. This can rescue calls blocked by neighbour bleed. Default False. Alpha.
records.translation: Undir ops_prefix_quality_method 'recipe_simple' skal hunsa minnihlutastrikamerki sem hefur flesta aflestra í snertandi frumu þegar ops_read_neighbour_discount er undir 1. Efstu strikamerki með jafnmarga aflestra haldast. Þetta getur bjargað strikamerkjaúthlutunum sem leki frá nágrönnum hindrar. Sjálfgefið False. Alpha.

records.source: Weighs down a minority guide when the same guide has the most reads in a neighbouring cell, with ties kept. Neighbours are nuclei whose discs come within ops_footprint, or touching cells in the spacer-prefix decode. 1 is off and 0 ignores flagged reads. The spacer-prefix decode uses the discount with 'weighted_majority'; under 'recipe_simple', ops_prefix_bleed_in_recipe enables ignoring flagged minority barcodes. A notice reports paths where the default cannot act. Default 0.25.
records.translation: Dregur úr vægi minnihlutaleiðara þegar sami leiðari hefur flesta aflestra í nágrannafrumu, en jafntefli haldast. Nágrannar eru kjarnar þar sem skífurnar koma innan ops_footprint hver frá annarri, eða snertandi frumur í afkóðun bilsforskeyta. 1 er óvirkt og 0 hunsar merkta aflestra. Afkóðun bilsforskeyta notar afsláttinn með 'weighted_majority'; undir 'recipe_simple' gerir ops_prefix_bleed_in_recipe kleift að hunsa merkt minnihlutastrikamerki. Tilkynning greinir frá vinnsluleiðum þar sem sjálfgefna gildið getur ekki haft áhrif. Sjálfgefið 0.25.
